rules: Stable customer/pool/property identity binds every booking. Resource kinds are technician and vehicle; original full intervals and explicit buffers remain.
Pool states active, paused or inactive retain effective and observed times. Historical visibility requires both. Latest effective state among observed events governs the explicit billing observation.
Expected visits retain actual source-declared series and explicit due windows, with expected or waived status. No recurrence instances are invented from natural language or calendar guesses.

Each route stop binds one exact booking revision and, when supplied, one same-pool explicit expected occurrence. Positive stop_sequence and route identity remain as supplied. Selected booking determines the current planned stop; compare planned order against actual observed arrivals within the same technician/route. No geocoding, road-time or route-distance inference.

Service versions bind exact job/revision with positive version and complete predecessor chain; captured time and later observed time remain separate. Status draft/final/voided is a field-record disposition, distinct from completion snapshot. work_json preserves full original service tasks; customer and internal notes remain distinct.

Readings retain literal analyte, original value_text, unit, method, measured and observed times. They are source records without numeric reinterpretation, dosage, thresholds, unit conversion or safety conclusions.

Media retains original reference, optional source-reported SHA-256, capture/observation and caption. Each report binds explicit reading and media IDs from its exact service version; later measurements/media cannot silently enter the retained report.

Report artifact binds exact service version and explicit member lists plus its source-reported digest. A later corrected service body preserves original report bytes/identity and marks the older binding.

Each delivery binds an exact report, actual recipient/channel, submission and observation. Delivery events are sent, delivered, failed, bounced or acknowledged; all require actual evidence_reference. Status follows occurrence time among observed events and retains last-observed event separately, so a late old callback cannot erase a newer outcome.

Billing periods explicitly declare start/end/counted_at/observed_at and supplied platform/per-pool rates in integer minor units. Full_month uses actual supplied rates; provided_prorated also requires original proration_reference. The model never invents a trial proration or a charged invoice.

At counted_at limited by the study as-of, count each distinct eligible pool with a selected scheduled/confirmed/in_progress/completed booking starting in the period or an independently completed service finishing in the period. A bare expected recurrence is not a scheduled job. Source-excluded pool statuses remain excluded. Missing status remains unresolved and makes the full rate comparison incomplete.
Subscription fee comparison is separate from customer job invoices, receipts, refunds and allocations. No actual charge or tax is inferred.

All eleven additional domains expose .key and reviews; retained future sources, full report, CSV and whole workspace include original histories. The browser/native wrapper preserves unfinished forms and original file bytes.
